verdict.rationale: Versioned APIs with a deprecation policy is a fair question for an API-first email service like AgentMail, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versioning, version identifiers, changelogs or a deprecation policy. The OpenAPI spec and SDKs show a documented API but say nothing about versioning or deprecation guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
